name: Reeltern 0.7.0 · Desktop Studio Apps, Antigravity MCP & AI Director
body:
## Reeltern 0.7.0 — Live Preview Workstation & Desktop Studio Upgrade

Edit directly in the redesigned **Reeltern Studio** standalone desktop app (macOS Apple Silicon & Intel, Windows x64, Linux x64), the CLI, or **31 AgentFlight Grade-A MCP tools** across **Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code**, and other local clients.

### Standalone Desktop Studio Apps (Zero Python Setup)

- **macOS Apple Silicon (.dmg):** `Reeltern-Studio-0.7.0-macos-arm64.dmg`
- **macOS Intel (.dmg):** `Reeltern-Studio-0.7.0-macos-x64.dmg`
- **Windows x64 (.zip):** `Reeltern-Studio-0.7.0-windows-x64.zip` (`Reeltern Studio.exe`)
- **Linux x64 (.tar.gz):** `Reeltern-Studio-0.7.0-linux-x64.tar.gz` (`reeltern-studio` + desktop entry)

### Python CLI & MCP Installation Bundles

- **Windows CLI Bundle:** `reeltern-0.7.0-windows-python.zip`
- **macOS CLI Bundle:** `reeltern-0.7.0-macos-python.zip`
- **Linux CLI Bundle:** `reeltern-0.7.0-linux-python.zip`
- **Existing Python environment:** `reeltern-0.7.0-py3-none-any.whl`
- **Source:** `reeltern-0.7.0.tar.gz`
- **Download verification:** `SHA256SUMS.txt`

### What is new in 0.7.0

- **Real-Time In-Window Program Monitor (`reeltern/preview.py`):** Live PyAV frame decoder and LGPL filter compositor inside **Reeltern Studio** rendering all 10 color grades (`teal_orange`, `cinematic`, true monochrome `noir`, `vintage`, `vivid`, `studio`, etc.), `blur_fill` vertical halo framing, Ken Burns preview, fades, brightness/contrast/saturation, lower-third title overlays, animated progress bar preview, toggleable safe-zone/rule-of-thirds guides, and a `Live` vs `Rendered` switch.
- **Flagship Obsidian NLE Workstation UI (`reeltern/studio.py`, `reeltern/studio_widgets.py`):** Custom flat `PillButton`, `ToggleSwitch`, smooth `ParamSlider`, `ScrollablePane`, and `MetricTile` KPI widgets across a 4-tab Inspector (`✦ Director` visual cards, `Look & FX` 2×5 grade swatch grid & live sliders, `Trim & Clip` `[ Mark In` / `Mark Out ]` & speed presets, `Mix & QA` toggles + inline LUFS/Peak/Luma/Black audit scorecard & `render_contact_sheet.png`), plus a multi-track `V1/T1/A1` visual timeline with clip thumbnails and keyboard shortcuts (`Space`, `←/→`, `I`, `O`, `S`, `⌘Z`).
- **One-Click Working Demo & Trim Fixes (`reeltern/demo.py`, `reeltern/studio.py`):** Shared active renderer cleanly during **Load Demo** so **Load Demo** immediately populates demo footage, timeline thumbnails, rendered MP4 switcher, storyboard, waveform, and Audit QA inside **Reeltern Studio**; fixed playhead-relative `[ Mark In` / `Mark Out ]` source offset calculation.

### Release checks & limits

Publication is gated on core unit tests across Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS (Python 3.10–3.12), documentation validation, OS bundle smoke tests, plus standalone Desktop Studio binary builds and MCP stdio handshake smoke tests across all four runners (`macos-15`, `macos-15-intel`, `windows-2022`, `ubuntu-22.04`). Bundles and `.dmg`/`.exe` builds remain unsigned (ad-hoc signed on macOS).

[Showcase & Downloads](https://codesphere-u.github.io/reeltern/) · [Install guide](https://github.com/codesphere-u/reeltern/blob/v0.7.0/docs/releases.md) · [AI setup](https://github.com/codesphere-u/reeltern/blob/v0.7.0/docs/clients.md) · [Validation](https://github.com/codesphere-u/reeltern/blob/v0.7.0/VALIDATION.md)

- **Source:** `reeltern-0.6.0.tar.gz`

### What is new in 0.6.0

- **Native Cross-OS Desktop Studio Executables:** Built with bundled FFmpeg (`imageio-ffmpeg`), PyAV, Tkinter dark workstation UI, and headless CLI/MCP stdio support inside `packaging/desktop_entry.py` and `scripts/build_desktop_app.py`. Double-click to open Studio cleanly (`~/ReelternWorkspace` default writable directory), or pass `mcp --workspace ... --media-root ...` for headless MCP stdio.
- **First-Class Antigravity MCP Support:** Added `antigravity` to `mcp-config` (`~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json`), `examples/clients/antigravity.json`, documentation, and the website hero/docs configurators.
- **One-Click Studio Onboarding:** Added **Load Demo** (loads synthetic footage, storyboard, waveform, and timeline immediately), **Workspace…** folder switcher, and **Connect AI** live configuration copy modal inside **Reeltern Studio**, plus `reeltern studio` CLI alias.
- **Resilient Atomic State I/O:** Hardened workspace JSON reads/writes and render segment promotion (`atomic_json`, `atomic_replace`, `read_json`) against transient Windows file-sharing locks during concurrent MCP status polling.

### Release checks & limits

Publication is gated on core unit tests across Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS (Python 3.10–3.12), documentation validation, OS bundle smoke tests, plus standalone Desktop Studio binary builds and MCP stdio handshake smoke tests across all four runners (`macos-15`, `macos-15-intel`, `windows-2022`, `ubuntu-22.04`). Bundles and `.dmg`/`.exe` builds remain unsigned (ad-hoc signed on macOS).

name: Reeltern 0.5.0 · Local editing for people and AI
body:
## Reeltern 0.5.0 — AI Director, creator-grade polish, and closed-loop QA

Edit through Reeltern Studio (desktop), the command line, or **31 AgentFlight Grade-A MCP tools** for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, and other local clients.

### Downloads

- **Windows:** `reeltern-0.5.0-windows-python.zip`
- **macOS (Apple Silicon or Intel):** `reeltern-0.5.0-macos-python.zip`
- **Linux:** `reeltern-0.5.0-linux-python.zip`
- **Existing Python environment:** `reeltern-0.5.0-py3-none-any.whl`
- **Source:** `reeltern-0.5.0.tar.gz`
- **Download verification:** `SHA256SUMS.txt`

**These are Python installation bundles, not standalone native apps.** Install Python first (3.12 recommended), extract the ZIP, and run `python3 install.py` on macOS/Linux or `py -3.12 install.py` on Windows. The installer creates a private `.venv` and installs dependencies locally without changing global packages. See the included `START-HERE.md`.

### What is new in 0.5.0

- **AI Director (`compose_video` / `reeltern compose --style ...`):** One-call production presets (`cinematic`, `viral_reel`, `tutorial`, `documentary`, `noir_trailer`) pairing silence trimming, intro slates, aspect framing, motion, color grading, voice cleanup, music ducking, loudness normalization, and captions.
- **Closed-loop render QA (`audit_render` / `reeltern audit JOB_ID`):** Measures EBU R128 integrated loudness (`-16 LUFS`), true peak, luminance, contrast, near-black frames, rendered contact sheet PNGs, and actionable repair fixes.
- **Creator-grade video & audio:** `blur_fill` vertical halo framing, Ken Burns camera motion (`zoom_in`, `zoom_out`, `pan_left`, `pan_right`), **10 color grades**, **10 `xfade` transitions**, `kinetic` word-highlight burned ASS captions, sliding bottom `progress_bar`, `voice_cleanup` EQ/compressor, and `import_audio` + `sidechaincompress` music ducking.
- **MCP visual inspection & ergonomics:** Expanded to **31 tools (`100/100 Grade A`, `0` errors, `0` warnings)**, binary PNG resource templates (`reeltern://visual/asset/{asset_id}`, `reeltern://visual/render/{job_id}`), `reeltern://cookbook`, and `viral_short` / `polish_edit` prompts.

### Release checks & limits

Publication is gated on core unit tests (`53` checks locally, including pixel, audio, CLI, Studio Tk, and live stdio MCP checks) plus clean bundle installation, real demo render, cache-reuse checks, and 31-tool MCP handshake across Python 3.10–3.12 on Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS. Python and internet access are required for bundle dependency setup; GUI requires Tkinter. Bundles remain unsigned; there is still no built-in speech recognition or face tracking.

[Showcase & Downloads](https://codesphere-u.github.io/reeltern/) · [Install guide](https://github.com/codesphere-u/reeltern/blob/v0.5.0/docs/releases.md) · [AI setup](https://github.com/codesphere-u/reeltern/blob/v0.5.0/docs/clients.md) · [Validation](https://github.com/codesphere-u/reeltern/blob/v0.5.0/VALIDATION.md)

name: Reeltern 0.3.2 · Local editing for people and AI
body:
## Reeltern 0.3.2 — local editing for people and AI

First packaged GitHub preview release. Edit through the desktop, command line, or 21 MCP tools for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code and other local clients.

### Downloads

- **Windows:** `reeltern-0.3.2-windows-python.zip`
- **macOS (Apple Silicon or Intel):** `reeltern-0.3.2-macos-python.zip`
- **Linux:** `reeltern-0.3.2-linux-python.zip`
- **Existing Python environment:** `reeltern-0.3.2-py3-none-any.whl`
- **Source:** `reeltern-0.3.2.tar.gz`
- **Download verification:** `SHA256SUMS.txt`

**These are Python installation bundles, not standalone native apps.** Install Python first (3.12 recommended), extract the ZIP, and run `python3 install.py` on macOS/Linux or `py -3.12 install.py` on Windows. The installer creates a private environment and downloads dependencies from your configured package index. It does not install model weights or change global Python packages. See the included `START-HERE.md`.

### What works

- Reversible source-based cut plans, trim/reorder/speed, and silence-assisted first passes.
- Supplied SRT transcripts, cue selection and retimed selectable captions.
- Optional local Ollama editorial drafts with source evidence and bounded validation.
- Verified previews/exports, cached segments and explicit interrupted-job retry.
- Client configuration generation, 21 MCP tools, implementation docs and an executable example.

### Release checks

Publication is gated on core tests and a clean bundle installation, real demo render, cache-reuse check and MCP handshake for Python 3.10, 3.11 and 3.12 on Ubuntu 22.04 x64, Windows Server 2022 x64, macOS 15 Apple Silicon and macOS 15 Intel. These checks do not certify every desktop OS version or GUI interaction.

### Limits

Early preview. Python and an internet connection are required for installation. GUI use needs Tkinter and a desktop session. Bundles are unsigned. No built-in transcription, burned-in captions, face tracking or full multitrack editor. The original optional enhancement adapters remain experimental. AI suggestions require review. No PyPI, container image or GitHub Packages registry publication is included.

[Install guide](https://github.com/codesphere-u/reeltern/blob/v0.3.2/docs/releases.md) · [AI setup](https://github.com/codesphere-u/reeltern/blob/v0.3.2/docs/clients.md) · [Validation](https://github.com/codesphere-u/reeltern/blob/v0.3.2/VALIDATION.md) · [Roadmap](https://github.com/codesphere-u/reeltern/blob/v0.3.2/docs/roadmap.md)
